_comment_version: Policy language version. Always use 2012-10-17. Never use 2008-10-17 (older, fewer features).

Statement._comment_sid: Sid = Statement ID. Optional but recommended. Human-readable identifier for this statement.
Statement._comment_effect: Effect: Allow OR Deny. AWS DENIES everything by default. You must ALLOW what you need. An explicit DENY always overrides any ALLOW.
Statement._comment_action: Action: which AWS API calls are allowed/denied. Format: service:ApiCall. Use * for wildcard. s3:* means ALL S3 actions (dangerous!). List specific actions for least privilege.
Statement._comment_resource: Resource: which specific AWS resources this applies to. ARN format: arn:partition:service:region:account:resource. s3:::bucket = the bucket itself (for ListBucket). s3:::bucket/* = objects in bucket (for GetObject/PutObject). Use * for all resources (AVOID in production!)
Statement._comment_condition: Condition: optional extra restrictions. Only applies if condition is TRUE. Examples: restrict to specific region, IP range, require MFA, require HTTPS, time of day.

Statement._comment_deny: Explicit Deny ALWAYS wins. Even if another policy Allows this, this Deny overrides it. Use for: protecting critical resources unconditionally.
